title: Epic: Merge David's UI design choices into current branch per spec
description:
## Context
We are selectively merging UI design choices from David's branch (feat/sungai-design-language) into the current branch (eco-267-take-into-account-davids-ui-redesign). A spec sheet defines which elements to pick from each branch. The current branch (identical to staging) is the newer one with more features — we must NOT lose any features.

## Goals
- Apply David's fonts (Inter + EB Garamond) while keeping serif/sans-serif role distinction
- Adopt David's hero section design with current branch's sizing
- Merge card backgrounds from David with card structure from current branch
- Adopt David's collapsible sidebar with current branch's sub-item groups and background color
- Move explore page search/filters from header to page body (David's approach)
- Keep current branch's Bumicert card style on explore page
- Keep current primary/accent colors (do NOT adopt David's emerald colors)
- Skip breadcrumbs feature from David's design

## Key Constraints
- Do NOT change primary/accent colors — keep Satyam's deeper teal-green palette
- Do NOT add breadcrumbs
- Do NOT move sign-in button to sidebar — keep it in header
- Preserve all newer features (sub-item groups, AtprotoProvider, etc.)
- Ask Satyam about any conflicts rather than making assumptions

title: Switch fonts to Inter (sans) + EB Garamond (serif)
description:
## Files
- app/layout.tsx (modify)
- app/globals.css (modify)

## What to do
1. Replace font imports in app/layout.tsx:
   - Remove: Geist, Geist_Mono, Instrument_Serif, Cormorant_Garamond, Lisu_Bosa, Baskervville
   - Add: Inter from "next/font/google" with variable --font-inter, subsets: ["latin"]
   - Add: EB_Garamond from "next/font/google" with variable --font-garamond, subsets: ["latin"], weight: ["400", "500", "600", "700"]
   - Update body className to: ${inter.variable} ${garamond.variable} antialiased h-screen

2. Update CSS variables in app/globals.css inside @theme inline:
   - --font-serif: var(--font-garamond);
   - --font-sans: var(--font-inter);
   - --font-mono: var(--font-inter);

3. Add explicit font-family rules in @layer base in app/globals.css:
   - body { font-family: var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; }
   - h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { font-family: var(--font-garamond), "Times New Roman", serif; }

4. Add custom scrollbar styles from David's branch (the "Sungai style" scrollbar CSS block targeting .overflow-y-auto). Place it after the @layer base block.

## Don't
- Do NOT change any color variables (--primary, --accent, --foreground, etc.) — keep ALL current color values exactly as they are
- Do NOT remove the AtprotoProvider import or any other providers from layout.tsx
- Do NOT change any provider nesting order in layout.tsx
- Do NOT touch anything outside fonts and scrollbar
acceptance_criteria:
1. Inter and EB_Garamond are the only font imports in layout.tsx
2. CSS variables --font-serif, --font-sans, --font-mono point to garamond, inter, inter respectively
3. Body has explicit font-family rule for Inter
4. All h1-h6 have explicit font-family rule for EB Garamond
5. Custom scrollbar styles are present for .overflow-y-auto
6. All color CSS variables are UNCHANGED from current branch
7. All providers (AtprotoProvider, TrpcProvider, etc.) are still present and in same order
8. bun run build succeeds (no missing font references)

title: UserOptionCards: David's gradient bg + messaging, Satyam's card structure
description:
## Files
- app/(marketplace)/_components/Home/UserOptionCards.tsx (modify)

## What to do
Keep Satyam's card structure (grid layout, icon placement, button placement) but apply David's gradient background and messaging.

### Background changes (from David):
- Replace bg-foreground/3 backdrop-blur-md with David's gradient: bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-primary/5
- Add David's border: border border-border/30
- Add David's background blur decorations inside each card:
  <div className="absolute -right-12 -top-12 w-48 h-48 bg-primary/5 rounded-full blur-3xl" />
  <div className="absolute -left-12 -bottom-12 w-32 h-32 bg-primary/3 rounded-full blur-2xl" />
- Add relative overflow-hidden to the card container (needed for blur decorations and absolute positioning)
- Add hover effects from David: hover:border-primary/30 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-primary/5 transition-all duration-500

### Messaging changes (from David):
- Card 1 title: "Discover impact" (was "I want to support a project.")
- Card 1 description: "Explore verified conservation projects from communities worldwide. Find work that resonates with you and support it directly."
- Card 2 title: "Certify your work" (was "I am an organization.")
- Card 2 description: "Turn your conservation efforts into verifiable digital certificates. Connect with funders who share your mission."

### Keep from Satyam (do NOT change):
- Grid layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 mt-4 gap-4
- Icon placement: absolute positioned at top-3 left-4 with opacity-50
- Icons: HandHeartIcon and TreesIcon (keep Satyam's icons)
- Button placement: absolute at top-2 right-2
- Button text: "Explore bumicerts" and "Create a bumicert" with ArrowRight
- Font styling for titles: font-serif text-primary font-bold text-3xl
- The pt-20 padding approach

## Don't
- Do NOT change the grid layout or gap
- Do NOT change icons or button text
- Do NOT add framer-motion animations to these cards
acceptance_criteria:
1. Cards have gradient background bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-primary/5
2. Cards have border border-border/30 and hover effects
3. Blur decoration divs are present inside each card
4. Card 1 title is "Discover impact", Card 2 title is "Certify your work"
5. Descriptions match David's text
6. Grid layout is still grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 mt-4 gap-4
7. Icons are still HandHeartIcon and TreesIcon at absolute top-3 left-4
8. Buttons are still at absolute top-2 right-2
9. No framer-motion imports
10. bun run build succeeds

title: Header: Adopt David's lighter style, remove sidebar toggle and back button
description:
## Files
- components/global/Header/index.tsx (modify)

## What to do
Rewrite the Header component to match David's lighter design, but keep sign-in button in header.

### From David's design:
- Lighter visual weight: border-b border-border/60 backdrop-blur-sm bg-background/80 (instead of shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl)
- Remove the Sidebar toggle button (the <Sidebar> icon button that calls setOpenState())
- Remove the Back button (<ChevronLeft /> Back)
- Add a subtle ChevronRight expand button that only shows when sidebar is collapsed (!openState.desktop):
  {isCollapsed && (
    <Tooltip delayDuration={0}>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>
        <button 
          onClick={() => setOpenState(true, "desktop")} 
          className="p-1 text-muted-foreground/40 hover:text-muted-foreground transition-colors"
        >
          <ChevronRight size={14} strokeWidth={1.5} />
        </button>
      </TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent side="right" sideOffset={8}>
        Expand sidebar
      </TooltipContent>
    </Tooltip>
  )}
- Add min-h-[52px] to the header bar
- Use px-4 py-3 padding (instead of p-2)
- Use gap-2 (instead of gap-1)

### Keep from Satyam's design:
- The AtprotoSignInButton in the header (desktop only) with the vertical divider
- The leftContent, rightContent, subHeaderContent pattern from HeaderContext
- The z-20 and sticky top-0

### New imports needed:
- ChevronRight from lucide-react (instead of Sidebar, ChevronLeft)
- Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger from @/components/ui/tooltip
- Keep useNavbarContext for openState and setOpenState

### Imports to remove:
- Sidebar from lucide-react
- Button from ui/button (no longer needed — the expand button is a plain <button>)
- useRouter from next/navigation (Back button removed)

## Don't
- Do NOT add breadcrumbs
- Do NOT remove the AtprotoSignInButton or move it to sidebar
- Do NOT change the HeaderContext provider logic
acceptance_criteria:
1. Header has border-b border-border/60 backdrop-blur-sm bg-background/80 (no shadow-xl)
2. No Sidebar icon button in header
3. No Back button in header
4. ChevronRight expand button appears only when sidebar is collapsed
5. ChevronRight has Tooltip with "Expand sidebar"
6. AtprotoSignInButton still renders on desktop with vertical divider
7. leftContent, rightContent, subHeaderContent all still render
8. min-h-[52px] is set on the header bar
9. No useRouter import
10. bun run build succeeds

title: Desktop sidebar: Add collapsible behavior while preserving sub-item groups
description:
## Files - components/global/Navbar/desktop-navbar.tsx (modify — significant rewrite) - components/global/Navbar/NavbarLayout.tsx (modify) - components/global/Navbar/context.tsx (no change needed — already supports toggle) ## What to do ### desktop-navbar.tsx Merge David's collapsible sidebar behavior into the current branch's desktop navbar, while preserving the sub-item group feature. **From David (adopt):** 1. Collapsible width: isCollapsed ? "w-16" : "w-[240px]" with transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out overflow-hidden 2. Background: bg-background/50 (semi-transparent) 3. Logo + title in same line: Small 20x20 icon with serif title beside it (hidden when collapsed). Use with flex items-center gap-2: {!isCollapsed &&

{title}

} 4. Collapse button inside sidebar (ChevronLeft, only when expanded): {!isCollapsed && ( )} Wrap in Tooltip with "Collapse sidebar". 5. Collapsed nav items: icon-only with Tooltip on hover, w-8 h-8 rounded-md centered 6. Expanded nav items: Use David's plain link style with hover:bg-foreground/5 instead of Button components 7. Active state: Use the CURRENT branch's active state with primary color background for both expanded and collapsed views: variant="default" (primary colored background) for expanded view, and bg-primary text-primary-foreground for collapsed icon view 8. Theme toggle: David's icon+text when expanded, icon-only when collapsed **From Satyam (preserve):** 1. Sub-item groups (NavLinkGroup): The current branch has a feature where nav items can have children that expand/collapse. This MUST be preserved. When expanded sidebar: show parent with chevron, children indent below. When collapsed: show only parent icon; clicking it should expand the sidebar first. 2. The auto-expand logic: active group auto-expands, max 2 groups expanded at once 3. Background color for main content area: keep the current border/shadow/rounded styling on the main content wrapper ### NavbarLayout.tsx - Always render DesktopNavbar (don't conditionally hide it based on openState). The sidebar is always visible — it just collapses to icon-only width. - The main content area should always have the left margin/padding to account for the sidebar width. ## Don't - Do NOT add a sign-in button to the sidebar - Do NOT change context.tsx - Do NOT remove the sub-item group feature - Do NOT use David's emerald/green color scheme for active states — keep primary color
acceptance_criteria:
1. Sidebar collapses to w-16 and expands to w-[240px] with smooth CSS transition
2. Collapse button (ChevronLeft) is inside the sidebar, visible only when expanded
3. When collapsed, nav items show icon-only with Tooltip
4. When expanded, nav items show icon + text
5. Sub-item groups (NavLinkGroup with children) still work: expand/collapse with chevrons, auto-expand active, max 2 expanded
6. When collapsed, groups show only parent icon; clicking expands the sidebar
7. Active items use primary color background (not just bg-foreground/5)
8. Logo and title appear in same line (David's style)
9. No sign-in button in sidebar
10. NavbarLayout always renders DesktopNavbar (not conditional on openState)
11. Main content area always has border/shadow/rounded styling
12. bun run build succeeds

Let it stay in the header's top right." The current mobile navbar has a profile/account button that expands when open. **Remove this button entirely** — the account button at absolute right-2 top-2 with the expanding animation. Remove the related useModal, ProfileModal, AuthModal imports if they become unused. ### From Satyam (preserve): 1. **Background color**: Keep the current background. The mobile navbar currently inherits from the parent layout. Don't change it. 2. **Sub-item groups**: Keep the NavLinkGroup with children support, expand/collapse with ChevronUp/Down, auto-expand active groups logic. — this was for the expanding profile button animation. - Remove imports that are no longer needed after removing the profile button: UserAvatar, useModal, ProfileModal, ProfileModalId, AuthModal, AuthModalId, usePrivy (if only used for profile button) ## Don't - Do NOT change the background color - Do NOT remove sub-item groups - Do NOT change the grid layout - Do NOT add any new animations
acceptance_criteria:
1. No profile/account button in mobile navbar (the expanding circle button is removed)
2. No empty spacer div for profile button animation
3. Sub-item groups still work (expand/collapse with chevrons)
4. Active items still use primary color (variant="default")
5. Footer links still render
6. Menu/X toggle still works
7. No unused imports (UserAvatar, useModal, ProfileModal, AuthModal removed if unused)
